VERSION 3.29.1.0

AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE Item > SelectionContextualMenu#tools
        LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#convertToText
        INSERT {
        ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
            id: bibleStudyLookup
            objectName: "bibleStudyLookup"
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            visible: controller && (typeof controller.selectionContainsStroke === "undefined"
                                    || controller.selectionContainsStroke)
            type: tools.type
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/search"

            onClicked: {
                if (!controller || bibleStudyDialog.busy) {
                    return;
                }
                var scale = typeof sceneView !== "undefined" && sceneView && sceneView.defaultScale > 0
                            ? sceneView.defaultScale : 1;
                var strokes = controller.cloneSelectedItems(controller.currentLayer, scale);
                bibleStudyDialog.beginRecognition(strokes, selectionRoot);
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE DocumentToolSettings#documentViewTools
        INSERT {
        Rectangle {
            id: bibleStudyDialog
            z: 300
            visible: false
            anchors.top: parent.top
            anchors.topMargin: Math.min(140, parent.height * 0.07)
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            width: Math.min(820, parent.width - 96)
            height: bibleStudyPanel.implicitHeight + 48
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 3
            radius: 10

            property bool recognizing: false
            property bool lookingUp: false
            property bool editing: false
            property var placement: null
            readonly property bool busy: recognizing || lookingUp || bibleStudyCommand.running
            property var previousJob: null
            property int recognitionTicks: 0
            property string statusMessage: ""
            property string passageReference: ""
            property string passageContent: ""
            property string copyrightNotice: ""
            property string commandOutput: ""
            property string lookupMode: "passage"
            property var quoteMatches: []
            property string inkHeading: ""

            Component.onCompleted: {
                var top = parent;
                while (top && top.parent) {
                    top = top.parent;
                }
                if (top) {
                    parent = top;
                }
            }

            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

            Connections {
                target: root
                function onDocumentChanged() { bibleStudyDialog.close(); }
                function onCurrentPageChanged() { bibleStudyDialog.close(); }
                function onVisibleChanged() {
                    if (!root.visible) {
                        bibleStudyDialog.close();
                    }
                }
            }

            function beginEditing() {
                if (busy) {
                    return;
                }
                bibleStudyReference.cursorPosition = bibleStudyReference.length;
                bibleStudyReference.forceActiveFocus();
                editing = true;
                Qt.inputMethod.show();
            }

            function endEditing() {
                if (editing) {
                    editing = false;
                    Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                    bibleStudyReference.focus = false;
                }
            }

            function close() {
                endEditing();
                visible = false;
                recognizing = false;
                previousJob = null;
                placement = null;
                if (lookingUp) {
                    lookingUp = false;
                    if (bibleStudyCommand.running) {
                        bibleStudyCommand.terminateCommand(100);
                    }
                }
            }

            function beginRecognition(strokes, handler) {
                endEditing();
                placement = capturePlacement(handler);
                lookupMode = "passage";
                bibleStudyReference.text = "";
                clearPassage();
                statusMessage = "Reading handwriting…";
                previousJob = Recognizer.selectionToolJob;
                recognitionTicks = 0;
                recognizing = true;
                visible = true;
                Recognizer.startSelectionToolJob(strokes, Settings.handwritingConversionLanguage);
            }

            function clearPassage() {
                passageReference = "";
                passageContent = "";
                copyrightNotice = "";
                quoteMatches = [];
                inkHeading = "";
            }

            function finishRecognition(message) {
                recognizing = false;
                previousJob = null;
                statusMessage = message;
            }

            function checkRecognition() {
                if (!recognizing) {
                    return;
                }
                var job = Recognizer.selectionToolJob;
                if (!job || job === previousJob) {
                    if (recognitionTicks >= 15) {
                        finishRecognition("Handwriting conversion could not start. Enter the reference below.");
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if (job.error !== undefined && job.error !== RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NoError) {
                    finishRecognition("Could not read the selection. Check Wi-Fi and sign-in, or enter the reference below.");
                } else if (job.status === RecognitionJob.Status.Done) {
                    var text = (job.plainText || "").trim();
                    finishRecognition(text ? "" : "No handwriting recognized. Enter the reference below.");
                    if (text) {
                        bibleStudyReference.text = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ");
                        if (/\d+\s*:\s*\d+/.test(bibleStudyReference.text)) {
                            lookUp("passage");
                        } else {
                            lookupMode = "quote";
                        }
                    }
                } else if (recognitionTicks >= 50) {
                    finishRecognition("Handwriting conversion timed out. Enter the reference below.");
                }
            }

            function lookUp(mode) {
                var reference = bibleStudyReference.text.trim();
                if (busy || !reference) {
                    return;
                }
                endEditing();
                clearPassage();
                lookupMode = mode;
                statusMessage = mode === "quote" ? "Finding matches…" : "Looking up Scripture…";
                commandOutput = "";
                lookingUp = true;
                bibleStudyCommand.arguments = [mode === "quote" ? "tablet-quote" : "tablet-lookup", reference];
                if (bibleStudyCommand.startCommand(1000)) {
                    bibleStudyRequestTimeout.restart();
                } else {
                    lookingUp = false;
                    statusMessage = "Could not start Bible Study on this tablet.";
                }
            }

            function finishLookup() {
                bibleStudyRequestTimeout.stop();
                if (!lookingUp) {
                    return;
                }
                lookingUp = false;
                var result;
                try {
                    result = JSON.parse(commandOutput);
                } catch (err) {
                    statusMessage = "Bible Study returned an invalid result.";
                    return;
                }
                if (result && typeof result.error === "string") {
                    statusMessage = result.error;
                    return;
                }
                if (lookupMode === "quote" && result && Array.isArray(result.matches)) {
                    quoteMatches = result.matches;
                    statusMessage = quoteMatches.length ? "Choose a match to review it."
                                                       : "No matches. Try different words or keep it as heard.";
                    if (Array.isArray(result.warnings) && result.warnings.length) {
                        statusMessage += " " + result.warnings.join(" ");
                    }
                    bibleStudyScroll.contentY = 0;
                    return;
                }
                if (!result || typeof result.reference !== "string" || typeof result.content !== "string"
                    || typeof result.copyright !== "string") {
                    statusMessage = "Bible Study returned an invalid result.";
                    return;
                }
                statusMessage = "";
                passageReference = result.reference;
                passageContent = result.content;
                copyrightNotice = result.copyright;
                bibleStudyScroll.contentY = 0;
            }

            function chooseQuote(match) {
                clearPassage();
                passageReference = match.reference;
                passageContent = match.content;
                copyrightNotice = match.source + (match.url ? "\n" + match.url : "");
                inkHeading = match.heading;
                statusMessage = "";
                bibleStudyScroll.contentY = 0;
            }

            function keepAsHeard() {
                var captured = bibleStudyReference.text.trim();
                if (busy || !captured) {
                    return;
                }
                endEditing();
                clearPassage();
                passageReference = "As heard";
                passageContent = captured;
                copyrightNotice = "Wording and attribution unverified.";
                inkHeading = "As heard";
                statusMessage = "";
                bibleStudyScroll.contentY = 0;
            }

            function canInsertInk() {
                return sceneView.notePage && passageContent.length > 0;
            }

            function capturePlacement(handler) {
                var surface = parent;
                if (!surface || surface.width <= 0 || surface.height <= 0
                    || Math.abs(surface.width / surface.height - 0.75) > 0.04 || !sceneView.tileManager) {
                    return null;
                }
                var selected = handler.viewSelectionRect;
                var available = handler.availableSceneRect;
                if (selected.width <= 0 || selected.height <= 0) {
                    return null;
                }
                var start = handler.mapToItem(surface, selected.x, selected.y + selected.height);
                var origin = handler.mapToItem(surface, available.x, available.y);
                var edge = handler.mapToItem(surface, available.x + available.width,
                                             available.y + available.height);
                var sx = 1620 / surface.width;
                var sy = 2160 / surface.height;
                var left = Math.max(0, origin.x * sx) + 48;
                var right = Math.min(1620, edge.x * sx) - 55;
                return {
                    page: handler.page,
                    controller: handler.controller,
                    layer: handler.controller.currentLayer,
                    geometry: bibleStudyInkWriter.geometry(),
                    available: [Math.round(left), Math.round(Math.max(0, origin.y * sy) + 24),
                                Math.round(right), Math.round(Math.min(2160, edge.y * sy) - 54)],
                    bounds: [Math.round(Math.max(left, Math.min(start.x * sx, right - 920))),
                             Math.round(start.y * sy + 36),
                             Math.round(right),
                             Math.round(Math.min(2160, edge.y * sy) - 54)]
                };
            }

            function insertInk() {
                if (!placement || !sceneView.tileManager || placement.controller !== sceneView.controller
                    || placement.layer !== sceneView.controller.currentLayer
                    || placement.geometry !== bibleStudyInkWriter.geometry()) {
                    statusMessage = "Select the reference again on the upright notebook page to place the ink.";
                    return;
                }
                endEditing();
                visible = false;
                bibleStudyPlacement.openFor(placement, passageReference, passageContent, inkHeading);
            }

            Timer {
                interval: 400
                running: bibleStudyDialog.recognizing
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: {
                    bibleStudyDialog.recognitionTicks += 1;
                    bibleStudyDialog.checkRecognition();
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: bibleStudyRequestTimeout
                interval: 15000
                onTriggered: {
                    if (bibleStudyDialog.lookingUp) {
                        bibleStudyDialog.lookingUp = false;
                        bibleStudyDialog.statusMessage = "Lookup timed out. Check Wi-Fi and try again.";
                        bibleStudyCommand.terminateCommand(100);
                    }
                }
            }

            AsyncCommandExecutor {
                id: bibleStudyCommand
                command: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/rembiblestudy/entry"
                onStdOutAvailable: function (output) { bibleStudyDialog.commandOutput += output; }
                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (!running) {
                        bibleStudyDialog.finishLookup();
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                id: bibleStudyPanel
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.margins: 24
                spacing: 14

                Text {
                    text: "Bible Study"
                    font.bold: true
                    font.pixelSize: 34
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    text: "Look up a reference, or find a quote by phrase or Author — words."
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 68
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: bibleStudyReference.activeFocus ? 4 : 2
                    radius: 6

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.beginEditing()
                    }

                    TextInput {
                        id: bibleStudyReference
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 12
                        verticalAlignment: TextInput.AlignVCenter
                        color: "black"
                        clip: true
                        readOnly: bibleStudyDialog.busy
                        activeFocusOnPress: true
                        selectByMouse: true
                        maximumLength: 200
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        onActiveFocusChanged: {
                            if (activeFocus && !readOnly) {
                                bibleStudyDialog.editing = true;
                                Qt.inputMethod.show();
                            }
                        }
                        onTextEdited: {
                            bibleStudyDialog.clearPassage();
                            bibleStudyDialog.statusMessage = "";
                        }
                        onAccepted: bibleStudyDialog.lookUp(bibleStudyDialog.lookupMode)
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 68
                    spacing: 12

                    Button {
                        width: (parent.width - parent.spacing * 3) / 4
                        height: parent.height
                        text: "Close"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.close()
                    }
                    Button {
                        width: (parent.width - parent.spacing * 3) / 4
                        height: parent.height
                        text: "Look up"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        enabled: !bibleStudyDialog.busy && bibleStudyReference.text.trim().length > 0
                        onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.lookUp("passage")
                    }
                    Button {
                        width: (parent.width - parent.spacing * 3) / 4
                        height: parent.height
                        text: "Find quote"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        enabled: !bibleStudyDialog.busy && bibleStudyReference.text.trim().length > 0
                        onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.lookUp("quote")
                    }
                    Button {
                        width: (parent.width - parent.spacing * 3) / 4
                        height: parent.height
                        text: "As heard"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        enabled: !bibleStudyDialog.busy && bibleStudyReference.text.trim().length > 0
                        onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.keepAsHeard()
                    }
                }

                Button {
                    text: "Insert as ink"
                    font.pixelSize: 27
                    visible: bibleStudyDialog.canInsertInk()
                    enabled: bibleStudyDialog.busy === false
                    onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.insertInk()
                }

                Text {
                    visible: bibleStudyDialog.canInsertInk()
                    width: parent.width
                    text: "Leave blank space below the reference. Ink uses your primary pen."
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    font.pixelSize: 21
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: bibleStudyDialog.statusMessage.length > 0
                    text: bibleStudyDialog.statusMessage
                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    font.pixelSize: 26
                }

                Flickable {
                    id: bibleStudyScroll
                    width: parent.width
                    height: visible ? Math.min(bibleStudyPassage.implicitHeight,
                                               bibleStudyDialog.parent.height * 0.40) : 0
                    visible: bibleStudyDialog.passageContent.length > 0 || bibleStudyDialog.quoteMatches.length > 0
                    clip: true
                    contentWidth: width
                    contentHeight: bibleStudyPassage.implicitHeight

                    Column {
                        id: bibleStudyPassage
                        width: bibleStudyScroll.width
                        spacing: 12

                        Repeater {
                            model: bibleStudyDialog.quoteMatches
                            Rectangle {
                                width: bibleStudyPassage.width
                                height: quoteSummary.implicitHeight + 24
                                color: "white"
                                border.color: "black"
                                radius: 5
                                Text {
                                    id: quoteSummary
                                    anchors.left: parent.left
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    anchors.top: parent.top
                                    anchors.margins: 12
                                    text: modelData.reference + "\n" + modelData.content
                                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
                                    maximumLineCount: 4
                                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                                    font.pixelSize: 24
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: bibleStudyDialog.chooseQuote(modelData)
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Text {
                            width: parent.width
                            visible: bibleStudyDialog.passageReference.length > 0
                            text: bibleStudyDialog.passageReference
                            textFormat: Text.PlainText
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            font.bold: true
                            font.pixelSize: 32
                        }

                        Text {
                            width: parent.width
                            visible: bibleStudyDialog.passageContent.length > 0
                            text: bibleStudyDialog.passageContent
                            textFormat: Text.PlainText
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            font.pixelSize: 29
                        }

                        Text {
                            width: parent.width
                            visible: bibleStudyDialog.copyrightNotice.length > 0
                            text: bibleStudyDialog.copyrightNotice
                            textFormat: Text.PlainText
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            font.pixelSize: 21
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Item {
            id: bibleStudyPlacement
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 320
            visible: false

            property var original: null
            property var request: null
            property var footprint: null
            property string output: ""
            property string hint: ""
            property bool canWrite: false

            Component.onCompleted: {
                var host = parent;
                while (host && host.parent) {
                    host = host.parent;
                }
                if (host) {
                    parent = host;
                }
            }

            function samePage() {
                return original && root.visible && sceneView.notePage && sceneView.tileManager
                       && sceneView.page === original.page && sceneView.controller === original.controller
                       && sceneView.controller.currentLayer === original.layer
                       && bibleStudyInkWriter.geometry() === original.geometry;
            }

            function openFor(placement, reference, content, heading) {
                original = placement;
                request = { reference: reference, content: content, bounds: placement.bounds };
                if (heading) {
                    request.heading = heading;
                }
                visible = true;
                check();
            }

            function moveTo(x, y) {
                if (!samePage()) {
                    cancel();
                    return;
                }
                var area = original.available;
                var left = Math.round(x * 1620 / width);
                var top = Math.round(y * 2160 / height);
                left = Math.max(area[0], Math.min(left, area[2] - 280));
                top = Math.max(area[1], top);
                request.bounds = [left, top, area[2], area[3]];
                check();
            }

            function check() {
                if (!visible || bibleStudyPlacementCommand.running) {
                    return;
                }
                canWrite = false;
                footprint = null;
                output = "";
                hint = "Checking the passage area…";
                bibleStudyPlacementCommand.arguments = ["tablet-ink-check", JSON.stringify(request)];
                if (!bibleStudyPlacementCommand.startCommand(1000)) {
                    hint = "Could not check the passage area.";
                } else {
                    bibleStudyPlacementTimeout.restart();
                }
            }

            function finishCheck() {
                bibleStudyPlacementTimeout.stop();
                if (!visible) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!samePage()) {
                    hint = "The page moved. Tap Cancel and select the reference again.";
                    return;
                }
                var result;
                try {
                    result = JSON.parse(output);
                } catch (err) {
                    hint = "Could not check the passage area.";
                    return;
                }
                if (!result || !result.bounds) {
                    hint = ((result && result.error) || "Could not fit the passage.")
                           + " Tap a different spot.";
                    return;
                }
                footprint = result.bounds;
                updateAvailability();
            }

            function overlaps(a, b) {
                return b && b.width > 0 && b.height > 0
                       && a.x < b.x + b.width && a.x + a.width > b.x
                       && a.y < b.y + b.height && a.y + a.height > b.y;
            }

            function occupancy() {
                try {
                    const near = sceneView.mapFromItem(bibleStudyPlacement,
                                                       (footprint[0] - 8) * width / 1620,
                                                       (footprint[1] - 8) * height / 2160);
                    const far = sceneView.mapFromItem(bibleStudyPlacement,
                                                      (footprint[2] + 8) * width / 1620,
                                                      (footprint[3] + 8) * height / 2160);
                    const region = sceneView.tileManager.viewToScene(
                        Qt.rect(near.x, near.y, far.x - near.x, far.y - near.y));
                    if (!region || !(region.width > 0 && region.height > 0)) {
                        return "unknown";
                    }
                    const controller = sceneView.controller;
                    if (controller.isRootDocumentVisible && controller.rootDocumentLength > 0
                        && overlaps(region, controller.rootDocumentBoundingRect)) {
                        return "occupied";
                    }
                    if (typeof controller.getLineBoundingRectsToBeSelected !== "function") {
                        return "unknown";
                    }
                    const left = Math.floor(region.x);
                    const top = Math.floor(region.y);
                    const bounds = Qt.rect(left, top, Math.ceil(region.x + region.width) - left,
                                           Math.ceil(region.y + region.height) - top);
                    const lines = controller.getLineBoundingRectsToBeSelected(bounds);
                    if (!lines || typeof lines.length !== "number") {
                        return "unknown";
                    }
                    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                        if (overlaps(bounds, lines[i])) {
                            return "occupied";
                        }
                    }
                    return overlaps(bounds, controller.itemsBoundingRect) ? "unknown" : "clear";
                } catch (err) {
                    return "unknown";
                }
            }

            function updateAvailability() {
                const state = occupancy();
                canWrite = state !== "occupied";
                if (state === "occupied") {
                    hint = "There is ink or text in the outlined area. Tap a blank spot.";
                } else if (state === "unknown") {
                    hint = "Check that the outlined area is blank. Tap the page to move it.";
                } else {
                    hint = "The outlined area is clear. Tap the page to move it or write here.";
                }
            }

            function cancel() {
                if (!visible) {
                    return;
                }
                visible = false;
                if (bibleStudyPlacementCommand.running) {
                    bibleStudyPlacementCommand.terminateCommand(100);
                }
                if (samePage()) {
                    bibleStudyDialog.visible = true;
                }
            }

            function confirm() {
                if (!footprint || !samePage()) {
                    return;
                }
                updateAvailability();
                if (!canWrite) {
                    return;
                }
                if (bibleStudyInkWriter.queue(request, original.page, original.controller)) {
                    visible = false;
                    bibleStudyDialog.close();
                } else {
                    hint = bibleStudyInkWriter.message;
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root
                function onCurrentPageChanged() { bibleStudyPlacement.cancel(); }
                function onDocumentChanged() { bibleStudyPlacement.cancel(); }
            }

            Timer {
                id: bibleStudyPlacementTimeout
                interval: 3000
                onTriggered: {
                    bibleStudyPlacementCommand.terminateCommand(100);
                    bibleStudyPlacement.hint = "The placement check timed out. Tap a spot to retry.";
                }
            }

            AsyncCommandExecutor {
                id: bibleStudyPlacementCommand
                command: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/rembiblestudy/entry"
                onStdOutAvailable: function (data) { bibleStudyPlacement.output += data; }
                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (!running) {
                        bibleStudyPlacement.finishCheck();
                    }
                }
            }

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                preventStealing: true
                onClicked: function(mouse) {
                    if (!bibleStudyPlacementCommand.running) {
                        bibleStudyPlacement.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y);
                    }
                }
            }

            Rectangle {
                readonly property var area: bibleStudyPlacement.footprint
                visible: area !== null
                x: area ? area[0] * parent.width / 1620 - 5 : 0
                y: area ? area[1] * parent.height / 2160 - 5 : 0
                width: area ? (area[2] - area[0]) * parent.width / 1620 + 10 : 0
                height: area ? (area[3] - area[1]) * parent.height / 2160 + 10 : 0
                color: "transparent"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 3
            }

            Rectangle {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                y: bibleStudyPlacement.footprint && bibleStudyPlacement.footprint[1] * parent.height / 2160 < 174
                   ? parent.height - height - 16 : 16
                width: Math.min(parent.width - 100, 940)
                height: 142
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 3
                radius: 8

                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                Column {
                    z: 1
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    anchors.margins: 12
                    spacing: 8

                    Text {
                        width: parent.width
                        height: 52
                        text: bibleStudyPlacement.hint
                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                        font.pixelSize: 23
                    }

                    Row {
                        spacing: 12
                        Button {
                            width: 150
                            height: 56
                            font.pixelSize: 26
                            text: "Cancel"
                            onClicked: bibleStudyPlacement.cancel()
                        }
                        Button {
                            width: 190
                            height: 56
                            font.pixelSize: 26
                            objectName: "bibleStudyWriteHere"
                            text: "Write here"
                            enabled: bibleStudyPlacement.canWrite
                            onClicked: bibleStudyPlacement.confirm()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: bibleStudyInkWriter
            z: 1000
            anchors.top: parent.top
            anchors.topMargin: 32
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            width: Math.min(parent.width - 120, bibleStudyInkLabel.implicitWidth + 48)
            height: bibleStudyInkLabel.height + 28
            visible: message.length > 0
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 2
            radius: 6

            property string message: ""
            property string output: ""
            property string pending: ""
            property var expectedDocument: null
            property var expectedController: null
            property int expectedLayer: -1
            property int expectedPage: -1
            property string expectedGeometry: ""
            property bool cancelling: false

            function queue(request, page, controller) {
                if (pending || bibleStudyInkCommand.running) {
                    show("Bible Study is already writing ink.", false);
                    return false;
                }
                if (!root.visible || !sceneView.notePage || sceneView.page !== page
                    || sceneView.controller !== controller || !sceneView.tileManager) {
                    show("Open the notebook page and select the reference again.", false);
                    return false;
                }
                if (root.orientation.orientation !== WindowLayout.Orientation.Portrait) {
                    show("Turn the notebook upright before inserting ink.", false);
                    return false;
                }
                const tool = documentViewTools.primaryPen.tool;
                if (!documentViewTools.isWritingTool(tool) || tool === Line.Highlighter) {
                    show("Choose a writing pen as your primary tool first.", false);
                    return false;
                }
                bibleStudyInkRefresh.stop();
                expectedDocument = root.document;
                expectedController = controller;
                expectedLayer = controller.currentLayer;
                expectedPage = page;
                expectedGeometry = geometry();
                pending = JSON.stringify(request);
                cancelling = false;
                show("Lift the marker. Writing Scripture shortly…", true);
                bibleStudyInkDelay.restart();
                return true;
            }

            function geometry() {
                var origin = sceneView.tileManager.sceneToView(Qt.rect(0, 0, 10, 10));
                return [origin.x, origin.y, origin.width, origin.height,
                        sceneView.width, sceneView.height].join("/");
            }

            function stillOnPage() {
                return root.visible && root.document === expectedDocument && sceneView.notePage
                       && root.orientation.orientation === WindowLayout.Orientation.Portrait
                       && sceneView.page === expectedPage && sceneView.controller === expectedController
                       && sceneView.controller && sceneView.controller.currentLayer === expectedLayer
                       && sceneView.tileManager && geometry() === expectedGeometry;
            }

            function begin() {
                if (!stillOnPage()) {
                    pending = "";
                    show("The page moved. Select the reference again.", false);
                    return;
                }
                documentViewTools.activeTool = "primary";
                toolbar.selectPen("primary");
                if (!stillOnPage() || documentViewTools.activeTool !== "primary") {
                    pending = "";
                    show("The page or pen changed. Select the reference again.", false);
                    return;
                }
                show("Writing Scripture…", true);
                output = "";
                bibleStudyInkCommand.arguments = ["tablet-ink-write", pending];
                if (!bibleStudyInkCommand.startCommand(1000)) {
                    pending = "";
                    show("Could not start ink insertion.", false);
                }
            }

            function show(text, sticky) {
                message = text;
                bibleStudyInkStatusTimeout.stop();
                if (!sticky) {
                    bibleStudyInkStatusTimeout.restart();
                }
            }

            function refreshInk() {
                if (!stillOnPage() || !sceneView.viewport) {
                    return;
                }
                const viewport = sceneView.viewport;
                if (typeof viewport.markDirty === "function") {
                    viewport.markDirty(Qt.rect(0, 0, viewport.width, viewport.height));
                }
                if (root.ghostBuster && typeof root.ghostBuster.forceClearNow === "function") {
                    root.ghostBuster.forceClearNow("Scripture inserted");
                } else if (typeof EPFramebuffer !== "undefined"
                           && typeof EPFramebuffer.scheduleGhostRemoval === "function") {
                    EPFramebuffer.scheduleGhostRemoval();
                }
                viewport.requestRepaintDirty();
            }

            Timer {
                id: bibleStudyInkDelay
                interval: 520
                onTriggered: bibleStudyInkWriter.begin()
            }
            Timer {
                id: bibleStudyInkStatusTimeout
                interval: 3800
                onTriggered: bibleStudyInkWriter.message = ""
            }
            Timer {
                id: bibleStudyInkRefresh
                interval: 450
                onTriggered: bibleStudyInkWriter.refreshInk()
            }
            Timer {
                interval: 80
                repeat: true
                running: bibleStudyInkCommand.running && !bibleStudyInkWriter.cancelling
                onTriggered: {
                    if (!bibleStudyInkWriter.stillOnPage() || documentViewTools.activeTool !== "primary") {
                        bibleStudyInkWriter.cancelling = true;
                        bibleStudyInkCommand.terminateCommand(250);
                    }
                }
            }
            AsyncCommandExecutor {
                id: bibleStudyInkCommand
                command: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/rembiblestudy/entry"
                onStdOutAvailable: function (data) { bibleStudyInkWriter.output += data; }
                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (!running && bibleStudyInkWriter.pending) {
                        bibleStudyInkWriter.pending = "";
                        var result;
                        try {
                            result = JSON.parse(bibleStudyInkWriter.output);
                        } catch (err) {
                            result = {};
                        }
                        if (bibleStudyInkWriter.cancelling) {
                            bibleStudyInkWriter.show("Ink stopped because the page or tool changed.", false);
                        } else if (result.error) {
                            bibleStudyInkWriter.show(result.error, false);
                        } else if (result.strokes > 0) {
                            bibleStudyInkWriter.show("", false);
                            bibleStudyInkRefresh.restart();
                        } else {
                            bibleStudyInkWriter.show("Ink insertion did not finish.", false);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Text {
                id: bibleStudyInkLabel
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: parent.width - 32
                text: bibleStudyInkWriter.message
                color: "black"
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                font.pixelSize: 25
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
